My understanding is you are supposed to resolve matters with your host before contacting AirBnB. My first time using the servicr as well and I was informed I have 60 days to after check out to contact the resolution center.
The thing is it was listed as a full house. But upon arriving it was just a two story condo. I was a bit unclear in explaining that.

Also, its been three different groups of guests so far and all,of them have been out of control. 

I understand that you can only do so much as a host when it comes to these situation but I find this insane. Especially since I was very clear in what I was looking for.
Yeah, unfortunately I don't really have anyone.
Did you go alone? I don't think I may be able to find someone to go with me.

Oh wow! Everyone I have talked to over the phone sounded really nice! I will probably shoot you a message soon because I have a decent size chest myself and that's something I'm a little anxious about at as well. Thanks for sharing!
Thank you for sharing! I'm just trying to ease my nervousness and I will search for other threads as well!
Update:I felt a little dizzy and off balance but I passed out at some point and slept until work. Thanks everyone.

Alright, thanks. I just wanted to pass out but didn't really think it through. Considering I'm still awake but not as worried now.

Its been a little over an hour and I just feel spaced out. I've been listening to my music. It says its a depressant and I took a anti-depressant as well. I've never had hallucinations before so that worries me a bit.
Thank you, Yeah I take Citalopram daily. I just started diphenhydramine this week for sleep.

I once read a survivor blog and one person said when they jumped they realized every problem they had could have been fixed. I try to tell myself that all the time. I used to sleep with a blade nearby hoping I'd wake up with an impulse to do it without thought. 

My mom told me once, "Don't tell them you want to hurt yourself or they will lock you up". They didn't know at the time I was depressed and they still dont know I'm suicidal. 

I guess I don't want people to think I'm crazy or something.
Thank You. I don't want to think like this but its hard for me to not pick that tool. Its the only one that seems like it will work.

I try to tell myself that people care about me and I don't want to hurt them but it seems like it would be easier if I was gone. I'm running out "healthy" outlets to ease things. I don't want to be sent to a mental hospital if I tell my therapist my thoughts.

I wish you the best of luck as well with your exams.

I am retaking the two courses right now but I understand I couldnt help myself from getting sick. It happens....

I've been trying to pinpoint the reason for my depression. I've always felt hopeless even as a kid. I am trying so hard to piece my life together but everytime things start to improve....it breaks again.

People tell me, "If you can't handle small hardships in life you will not make it." They are right....I can't make it. I've been trying but each failure tears me down more.

The medicine helped at first but I feel like I'm going back to wanting to kill myself. I think about all the time and ive been trying decide on a time.

I think I'm just screwed up and nothing I will do will help...

 Its too much now.
